B.name: POSSESSIVE_DESCRIPTION
B.purpose: State a location fact with a natural possessive noun phrase or possessive determiner.

C.name: WHERE_QA
C.purpose: Ask and answer a Where question.
C.model_shape: Where is the ___? / It's under the ___.

D.name: CONFIRMATION_QA
D.purpose: Confirm or reject a proposed location.
D.model_shape: Is the ___ under the ___? / Yes, it is. / No, it isn't.

E.name: UNCERTAINTY
E.model_shape: I think the ___ is under the ___.

F.name: ACTION_PLUS_LOCATION
F.purpose: Use an action together with a location expression.

G.name: CHOICE_COMPARISON
G.purpose: Choose between two possible locations and answer clearly.
